profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. On its own site, the company describes itself as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. It says its platform is used by the world's largest organizations to build AI-powered processes that accelerate work, reduce cost, and manage risk, and that it has been automating processes for more than two decades. The site also states that Appian was recognized as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT) and among the highest three vendors in all BOAT use cases, and it references a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors and an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The site lists capabilities across process automation, artificial intelligence, and legacy application modernization, with use cases including accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier management, audit and compliance, case resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order fulfillment, and contract review. It says customers can build AI-powered apps without code, embed AI agents to extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts, and it claims onboarding time can be cut by up to 50 percent. Appian describes its platform as known for power, reliability, and scale.

The available record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Virginia, with a count of 152.
